title: Omusitula Obubaka Obw'entaana
intro: Omwoyo omutuukirivu gwasindikibwa okulungamya abantu abaabuze mu kusobya okutabangawo. Omubaka ono yayimirira nga munywevu, ng’awa okulabula okw’amaanyi ku nguzi eyali ejeemera enteekateeka ey’obutonde. Wadde nga waaliwo okwegayirira okw’amaanyi, ekitundu ekyo kyagenda mu maaso n’okubbira mu kizikiza, ne kiteekawo omutendera gw’okubalirira okw’obwakatonda okwawukana ku kulala kwonna. Osobola okutegeera omuddu wa Allah ono omunywevu?
clues: Nnali wa luganda lwa nnabbi omulala omukulu, era nnasenguka naye, ne nsigaza ensi yaffe.
Nasindikibwa eri abantu abalina obubi bwabwe obw’enjawulo, ekisobyo ekitali kitonde kyonna kye kyali kikoze mu maaso gaabwe.
Ennyumba yange yennyini yayawukana; omuntu ow’omu maka ow’oku lusegere yava ku ludda lw’abatakkiriza mu nkukutu.
Bamalayika, mu ngeri y’abavubuka abalungi, bajja mu maka gange ng’abagenyi, ne kindeetera ennaku ey’amaanyi olw’obukuumi bwabwe.
Nawaayo bawala bange bennyini mu bufumbo eri abantu bange nga ngezaako nnyo okubaggya ku bikolwa byabwe eby’ensonyi.
Abantu bange baasaanawo olw’okukaaba okw’entiisa n’enkuba y’amayinja ag’ebbumba eryafumbibwa, ate nze n’ab’omu maka gange, okuggyako omu, twawonyezebwa nga tuvaawo mu kiro ekizito.

trial.label: Kiki Ekisooka Okugezesebwa Kwaali?
options: Okumatiza kabaka omutyobooli obutannyokya muliro.
Okukolagana n’obuggya bwa baganda bange n’okusuulibwa mu luzzi.
Okwolekera abantu abeenyigira mu bikolwa eby’obugwenyufu ebitabangawo.
Okukulembera abantu bange okuva mu buddu okuva eri faraawo ow’amaanyi.
Okuzimba emmeeri ennene ennyo okutaasa abakkiriza okuva mu mataba amanene.
trial.answer: Okwolekera abantu abeenyigira mu bikolwa eby’obugwenyufu ebitabangawo.

outcome.label: Kiki Ekisembayo Ekyavaamu?
options: Ebibuga byamenyeka ne bitonnya amayinja ag’ebbumba eryafumbibwa.
Abantu bange ensi ne bagimira wamu n’omukulembeze waabwe omugagga.
Abantu bange baazikirizibwa empewo ey’amaanyi okumala ekiro musanvu n’ennaku munaana.
Abantu bange baali babonaabona n’ebibonyoobonyo ng’enzige, enkwale, n’ebikere.
Ekyennyanja ekinene ennyo kyanmira oluvannyuma lw’okusuula omulimu gwange.
outcome.answer: Ebibuga byamenyeka ne bitonnya amayinja ag’ebbumba eryafumbibwa.

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ
verse: So when Our command came, We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were] (11:82)
